note: Salted SHA-256 digests of the product and programme identities whose appearance in a publication bundle is a review trigger. The terms are held as digests so that this public repository does not publish the list it exists to check for.
non_claims: This is not secrecy. The digest set is small and the salt is public, so anyone who guesses a term can confirm it. Its purpose is to keep the terms out of the plaintext public surface, not to hide them from an adversary.
A trigger is a review trigger. It is not evidence that anything leaked.
